summary: This is a routine Form 8-K filed by New Peoples Bankshares, Inc. reporting the results of its 2026 Annual Shareholders Meeting held on May 19, 2026. The filing under Items 5.07 and 8.01 discloses the election of four directors to three-year terms and one director to a two-year term, plus ratification of the independent auditor. No special-situation event such as a merger, acquisition, tender offer, activist campaign, strategic review, going-private transaction, spin-off, restructuring, or capital return is involved. The filing is a standard current report on shareholder votes and does not constitute a special situation.
